# Helion documentation

Helion is an original FPGA device family plus the in-repo CAD (synth, pack, place, PathFinder route, STA, bitstream) and desktop IDE that target that family. Not a vendor-tool wrapper.

- Home: index.html
- Using Helion (IDE + CLI): use.html
- Getting started (download / build): start.html
- Architecture (crates, HAD, HNF): architecture.html
- Wiki index: wiki.html
- Get involved: get-involved.html
- Contributing (code): contribute.html
- Legal fence: legal.html
- Repository: https://github.com/helion-fpga/helion
- License: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
- Gold: empty-XDC examples/counter.sv WNS_PS=9640, LED[16]=0000000111111110
- Part: HL10T-C32-1 (HAD)
